name: World Of Wireless International Telecom, Inc.
summary: World Of Wireless International Telecom, Inc. (WWII) is an international communications firm that operates its own infrastructure within the wireless industry. Still in its developmental stage, the company primarily concentrates on delivering prepaid, unlimited softphone solutions. These comprehensive services feature voice communication, data access, text messaging, and media streaming, functioning whether connected to a specific "Hot Spot" or a general WiFi network, or independently. Furthermore, the organization actively pursues the investigation, advancement, and commercialization of new technologies. These innovations are intended for diverse sectors, including military, marine, and business applications, serving markets both within the United States and globally. Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, the entity previously traded as WiFi Wireless, Inc. until its rebranding to World Of Wireless International Telecom, Inc. in September 2017.
